page_title: LIV 2-0 WOL | Liverpool v Wolves 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' A pass travels right across the box to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Jose Sa denies him with a decent save.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' The goal by Matt Doherty (Wolves) won't count as it has been disallowed on the advice of the video assistant referee!
87' Matt Doherty (Wolves) puts the ball into the back of the net, but referee Chris Kavanagh immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
86' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Matt Doherty (Wolves) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
84' Here comes a substitution. Santiago Bueno is given a rest as he is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
81' Substitution. Cody Gakpo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Harvey Elliott will be replaced by Curtis Jones (Liverpool).
78' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Pedro Neto (Wolves) replaces Matheus Cunha.
78' Substitution. Hugo Bueno (Wolves) has come on for Rayan Ait-Nouri.
73' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) latches onto a cross and drills a shot towards goal that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
72' Liverpool have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) replacing Luis Diaz.
70' That will be all from Trent Alexander-Arnold who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Conor Bradley (Liverpool).

70' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the top left corner, but Jose Sa has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.
70' Substitution. Alexis Mac Allister is replaced by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool).
66' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
63' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde is replaced by Boubacar Traore (Wolves).
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Matt Doherty (Wolves) is replacing Hee-Chan Hwang.

60' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Wataru Endo (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. That's a free kick to Wolves.

59' A precise short pass from Trent Alexander-Arnold releases Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
56' The resulting set piece from Liverpool is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

55' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
55' Joao Gomes (Wolves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Liverpool.
53' Good movement by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
51' Chris Kavanagh couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Wataru Endo (Liverpool) and blew his whistle. Wolves have been awarded a free kick.
50' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Jose Sa is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
49' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' GOAL! Wait, the goal by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is not going to count as the ball ran out of play during the build up.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+8' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Wolves will take a free kick near the side line.
45+6' Liverpool failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+6' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
45+5' A corner kick by Liverpool is thwarted by the well prepared Jose Sa (Wolves).
45+5' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the top right corner, but Jose Sa reacts superbly to deny him. Now Liverpool have a corner.

45+1' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Toti (Wolves). Chris Kavanagh saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Free kick. Liverpool will probably just try to cross the ball in from here. Toti (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
45' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
43' Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight and sees a foul from Matheus Cunha (Wolves). Liverpool are awarded a free kick.
42' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' 2 - 0 Goal! Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:0.
40' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
40' The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

40' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Jose Sa pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) leaps like a salmon to produce a header from the resulting corner, but one of the defending players intercepts the ball and averts the danger.
37' The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.

34' 1 - 0 Harvey Elliott sends a superb cross into the box. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving Jose Sa beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:0.
33' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Liverpool comes to nothing.
29' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
28' Chris Kavanagh shows a red card with no hesitation. Nelson Semedo (Wolves) can have an early bath and think about his challenge.
28' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Nelson Semedo (Wolves)! Let's see what he decides.
27' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
26' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.

21' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
21' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

21' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolves.
17' Chance! Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
17' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

16' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Chris Kavanagh blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick has been awarded to Liverpool.
16' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
15' The possession of the ball – 84:16.
14' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
13' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Jose Sa watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
11' Liverpool quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
11' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
9' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
9' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
6' A great run by Joao Gomes (Wolves) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
4' Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul after Wataru Endo (Liverpool) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
2' Liverpool are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Wolves will kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
